name: Breville Group Limited
summary: Breville Group Limited engages in the design, development, marketing, and distribution of small electrical kitchen appliances in the Americas, the Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers appliances for the kitchen, such as slow cookers, kettles, and fry pans, as well as living room, laundry and bedroom, including irons, vacuums, heaters, electric blankets, and fans. The company also provides coffee machines, espresso, filter coffee, cooking, accessories, and design products; and toasters, coffee grinders, and home espresso equipment.
